cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-004: API Access (Programmatic Integration)

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-005: Local Lenses CLI (Command-Line Tools)

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-006: CI/CD Pipeline Integration
cards.description: This standard defines requirements and guidelines for integrating Lenses.io capabilities into CI/CD pipelines to enable automated deployment, testing, and validation of Kafka-related configurations and applications.

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-007: GitOps Workflow Integration
cards.description: This standard establishes requirements for implementing GitOps workflows to manage Lenses.io and Kafka infrastructure as code, enabling declarative configuration management, automated reconciliation, and version-controlled infrastructure changes. It defines the frameworks, processes, and governance needed to maintain Git as the single source of truth for all Kafka infrastructure configurations.

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-008: Consumer Lag Investigation Workflows
cards.description: This standard defines comprehensive workflows and procedures for investigating consumer lag issues using Lenses.io capabilities, enabling rapid identification and resolution of performance problems in Kafka consumer applications. It establishes structured investigation methodologies, correlation techniques, and remediation frameworks to minimize the business impact of consumer lag incidents.

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-009: Topic Data Inspection and Analysis
cards.description: This standard defines comprehensive procedures and best practices for inspecting and analyzing topic data using Lenses.io, enabling data quality validation, troubleshooting, compliance verification, and operational insights. It establishes structured approaches to message browsing, searching, validation, and analysis while maintaining data privacy and security requirements.

cards.title: STD-APP-KMGMT-010: Error Message Analysis and Troubleshooting
cards.description: This standard defines comprehensive procedures for analyzing error messages and patterns using Lenses.io to enable rapid incident response, root cause identification, and systematic resolution of Kafka-related issues.
